spans.s: + अर्थ किम्- + अर्थ, adj. with what aim,
+ म् किम्-अर्थ + म् adv. why, to what end,
+ आख्य किम्- + आख्य, adj. how called, Śāk. 104, 13.

किम्, except for the nom. and acc. sing. ntr., the base of the msc. and n. and most derivatives is क, of the fem. का,
 I. interrog. pron., sbst., and adj. Who, what, which,

; 9, 170; 8, 161.
 --With gen. Who, what in proportion to,

: के मम धन्विनोन्ये, What may the other archers be able to do against me?
 --With instr. Away with, e. g. किं विलम्बेन, Do not tarry,

. किं बहुना, In short, Pañc. 5, 3. किम् अनेन, No question, Śāk. 91, 7.
 --With instr. and [] gen. किं ते ज्ञातैर् महाधनुर्धरैः, What have you to do with knowing the great archers?

.
 --Instead of the instr. may be used also the absolutive, किं ते सूर्यम् निपात्य, What matters it to you to bring down the sun?

.
 --Joined with the demonstr. pron. इदम्, e. g. को यम्, Who there?

.
 --Doubled, e. g. किंकिं न करोति, What, what does he not? Pañc. i. d. 338.
 --It joins two questions in one sentence, e. g. का वाम् कं वरम् इच्छति, Who of you chooses the one and who the other boon?

; generally followed by,
 a., च, Bhāg.
; preceded by the relat. pron. यद्, Whoever, whatever,
; preceded by the relat. pron. यद्, Whatever,
; preceded by the relat. pron. यद्, α Whatever,

.
 d. अपि, see अपि.
 2. Any, Yājñ. 3, 133.
 3. Joined with न, Nobody,

.
 --With च न or न--च न, Nothing, nobody,
. मा किं च न, Not at all, Bhāg.
. न हि किं च न, Never,

; not the least, Pañc. 157, 6.
 III. किम् (acc. sing. ntr.) adv.
 1. Why,
. A particle of interrog., e. g. साम्यम् इच्छसि किम्, Are you really desirous of readmission to equality?

.
 --With following उ, किम् उ, How much [] more?

; go on, Śāk. 89, 17.
 --With following तु, But,

.
 --With following नु,
 1. It lays a stress on the interrogation,

.
 --A following वा increases the doubt, Śāk. 105, 7; Pañc. 44, 21.
 --In disjunctive questions we find, किम्--किं वा, Śṛṅgārat. 7. किम्--किं वा--किं वा, Pañc. 34, 15 (तत् किम्...शस्त्रेण मारयामि, किं वा विषम् प्रयच्छामि, किं वा पशुधर्मेण व्यापादयामि, Shall I kill him with a knife, or shall I give him poison, or shall I kill him like a beast?). किम्--किम्--वा--अथ,
. किम् is sometimes the former part of a compound word, e. g. किंरूप, adj. How shaped? Pañc. 258, 13. किंचिद् is also the latter part of compound words, e. g. किंचिज्ज्ञ, adj. Knowing a little,

.
 --Cf. कस्मात् separately.
 --Cf. κο, πο, e. g. κῆ, πῆ, πόθι, etc.; Lat. quis, qui, etc.; Goth. hvas; A.S. hva.
किमिच्छक, i. e. किम्-इच्छा + क, adj. Desirable,
किम् + ईय, adj. To whom belonging,
+ प्रभु किम्- + प्रभु, m. A bad master, Hit. ii. d. 31 (read किंप्रभु).
+ बल किम्- + बल, adj. possessed of what a power, Bhāg.
